title: Practice 1: до-: as far as, reaching

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **довели** is the past tense (plural) of **довести** (to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **доводить**. past: он довёл · она довела́ · оно довело́ · они довели́. — Wiktionary, «довести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**до-** — Reaching a limit or destination Example: Пассажиры доехали до последней остановки и вышли из автобуса. — The passengers reached the last station and exited the bus. Prepositional phrases: до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «"Going verbs" with prefix "до-" indicate motion up to a certain point and may mean: a) going as far as …; b) reaching of a destination. Я доехал до угла и повернул направо. (went as far as…) У меня было мало бензина, но я всё-таки доехал до города. (reached the destination) These verbs are always followed by the preposition до + Gen.» — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: **довело** is the past tense (neuter) of **довести** (to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **доводить**. past: он довёл · она довела́ · оно довело́ · они довели́. — Wiktionary, «довести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**до-** — Reaching a limit or destination Example: Пассажиры доехали до последней остановки и вышли из автобуса. — The passengers reached the last station and exited the bus. Prepositional phrases: до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «"Going verbs" with prefix "до-" indicate motion up to a certain point and may mean: a) going as far as …; b) reaching of a destination. Я доехал до угла и повернул направо. (went as far as…) У меня было мало бензина, но я всё-таки доехал до города. (reached the destination) These verbs are always followed by the preposition до + Gen.» — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
